blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— The Department of Education (DepEd) has been finalizing plans to relocate Manuel Luis Quezon High School–Manila from its present site in Santa Cruz due to health and structural concerns to a permanent one where a modern campus will be built. At present, the high school is on the second floor of a wet market near the LRT Blumentritt Station under a usufruct agreement with the city government. According to a DepEd statement last Friday, the school has experienced “severe infrastructure breakdowns” — inadequate toilets, leaking roofs, and chronic sanitation issues — which have forced it to temporarily switch to […]...
